_comment: Declared inventory of every repository secret the workflows are allowed to reference.
NAMES AND PURPOSES ONLY. Never put a value in this file.
This file exists because actionlint cannot catch a typo'd or deleted secret: the
`secrets` context is an open map, so `secrets.APPSTORE_USERNAME` type-checks fine
even though that secret has never existed in this repository. It sat in deploy.yml
for months. scripts/check_secret_inventory.py cross-checks this file against the
workflows in both directions, so an undeclared reference and a stale declaration are
Declaring a secret here does NOT mean it is set. Run the 'Release secrets preflight'
workflow to see which of these are actually present on the repository.

secrets.name: APPLE_DISTRIBUTION_CERTIFICATE_P12
secrets.purpose: Apple Distribution certificate and private key exported together as a password-protected p12 for manual iOS and macOS archive signing.

secrets.name: APPLE_DISTRIBUTION_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Export password for APPLE_DISTRIBUTION_CERTIFICATE_P12.

secrets.name: APPLE_IOS_APP_STORE_PROFILE
secrets.purpose: Base64-encoded iOS App Store profile for com.sats21m.masonsbudget and team 384ZGKG4GB.

secrets.name: APPLE_MAC_APP_STORE_PROFILE
secrets.purpose: Base64-encoded macOS App Store profile for com.sats21m.masonsbudget and team 384ZGKG4GB.

secrets.name: APPLE_MAC_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_P12
secrets.purpose: Mac Installer Distribution certificate and private key exported together for the TestFlight pkg.

secrets.name: APPLE_MAC_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Export password for APPLE_MAC_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_P12.

secrets.name: ASC_API_KEY_P8
secrets.purpose: App Store Connect API private key (.p8), base64-encoded. Used by altool instead of an Apple ID.

secrets.name: ASC_KEY_ID
secrets.purpose: App Store Connect API key id.

secrets.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID
secrets.purpose: App Store Connect API issuer id.

secrets.name: ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64
secrets.purpose: Stable debug keystore for the manual same-signed Android APK workflow and its read-only release preflight.

secrets.name: ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Store password for ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64. Omit to use the standard Android debug password.

secrets.name: ANDROID_DEBUG_KEY_ALIAS
secrets.purpose: Key alias inside ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64. Omit to use the standard 'androiddebugkey'.

secrets.name: ANDROID_DEBUG_KEY_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Key password inside ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64. Omit to use the standard Android debug password.

secrets.name: ANDROID_READ_BOOTSTRAP_PAIR
secrets.purpose: Required pairing input for android-read-bootstrap.yml, the retained manual same-signed Android enrollment workflow. Mint a fresh one-time read + todo-write bootstrap with the guarded repository helper for each approved run.
secrets.absent_note: Required for android-read-bootstrap.yml; not required for the standard release workflow.

secrets.name: BUZZ_DEVELOPER_ID_P12_B64
secrets.purpose: Dedicated Buzz Developer ID Application identity with private key and Apple intermediate chain; team 384ZGKG4GB.
secrets.absent_note: Required only for the separately approved manual Buzz Mac workflow.

secrets.name: BUZZ_DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: URL-safe export password for the dedicated Buzz Developer ID p12.
secrets.absent_note: Required only for the separately approved manual Buzz Mac workflow.

secrets.name: BUZZ_TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.purpose: Retained Buzz Tauri updater private key with empty password; never supplied to source builds.
secrets.absent_note: Required only for the separately approved manual Buzz Mac workflow.

secrets.name: BUZZ_IOS_APP_STORE_PROFILE
secrets.purpose: Buzz App Store provisioning profile for com.sats21m.buzz, team 384ZGKG4GB.
secrets.absent_note: Required only for the separately approved manual Buzz iOS workflow.

secrets.name: BUZZ_IOS_NSE_APP_STORE_PROFILE
secrets.purpose: Buzz App Store provisioning profile for com.sats21m.buzz.NotificationService, team 384ZGKG4GB.
secrets.absent_note: Required only for the separately approved manual Buzz iOS workflow.

secrets.name: BUZZ_TESTFLIGHT_RECIPIENT_20260908
secrets.purpose: Temporary private operator input for the single approved Buzz TestFlight recipient; remove after terminal distribution.

secrets.name: BUZZ_TESTFLIGHT_REVIEW_20260908
secrets.purpose: Temporary private JSON of separately reviewed Buzz beta metadata operator values; remove after terminal metadata update. No demo-account passwords.
